title: Kill Count
description: A lightweight server-side mod that tracks player-vs-player kills and exposes them through a single command.
body:
- **Per-player tracking** — kills are tied to player UUIDs, so name changes don't lose your stats
- **Persistent** — counts are saved with the world and survive server restarts
- **Indirect kills counted** — bow, crossbow, and trident kills all attribute to the shooter
- **No self-kills** — dying to your own TNT or fall damage doesn't pad your count
- **Works everywhere** — singleplayer, LAN, and dedicated servers
- **Server-side only** — clients don't need the mod installed to join a server running it
